en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside scene with a grand castle‑like building on a wooded hill to the right, labeled "Schloss." A metal truss bridge spans the river on the left, leading into a small settlement. People are visible walking along the riverbank and near the water. The main caption in red at the top left reads "Gruss aus Aich b. Karlsbad." and a publisher line appears at the bottom.
